readyClaimAllowedOnlyWhen: SEIS-SSH resolves to direct-cloud SSH without ProxyCommand
TCP reachability succeeds against the configured public SSH endpoint
SSH key authentication succeeds in BatchMode
SEIS repository is present on the remote host
strict doctor writes a successful readiness handoff report
blockedClaimWhen: SEIS-SSH points at localhost or the local Mac
remote runtime or SSH-AI daemon is offline

evidenceMap.proves: local direct-cloud profile inputs are present
public-key-only bootstrap command is well formed
remote VM was bootstrapped with the selected public key and runtime user
managed SEIS-SSH block can be rendered without writing local SSH config
local SEIS-SSH managed block is installed
direct-cloud transport, TCP reachability, SSH auth, and remote runtime readiness
strict readiness report was written and passed
repo contract, scripts, docs, ignore rules, and safety invariants are wired

nonEvidence: A generated profile alone does not prove mobile 24x7 readiness.
A dry-run bootstrap plan alone does not prove remote bootstrap.
A green governance check alone does not prove the cloud VM is reachable.
A Codespaces SSH alias does not prove 24x7 mobile readiness.

decisionMatrix.allowedClaim: terminal fallback may work, but it is not mobile 24x7
bootstrap command is ready for review
local SSH client has a managed SEIS-SSH block

remediationOrder: Set SEIS_SSH_HOST to the always-on public VM endpoint.
Run bootstrap:plan and inspect the public key fingerprint before apply.
Run bootstrap:apply only when root SSH access to the VM is confirmed.
Install the managed SEIS-SSH config block.
Run the strict probe to prove transport, TCP, SSH auth, and runtime readiness.
Run the strict doctor to write the final mobile handoff report.

mobileHandoffChecklist.requirement: ChatGPT mobile/Codex uses the single SEIS-SSH alias and does not depend on the local Mac.
mobileHandoffChecklist.evidence: ssh -G SEIS-SSH shows direct-cloud transport without ProxyCommand.

mobileHandoffChecklist.requirement: The SSH endpoint is an always-on public VM or DNS name.
mobileHandoffChecklist.evidence: npm run cloud:ssh:mobile-direct:probe:strict passes TCP reachability and SSH auth.

mobileHandoffChecklist.requirement: Remote runtime can serve SEIS work after mobile reconnection.
mobileHandoffChecklist.evidence: strict probe reports remote runtime online and SEIS repository present.

mobileHandoffChecklist.requirement: A reusable readiness report exists for future device migration.
Private keys, API keys, tokens, and runtime secrets remain outside git.
mobileHandoffChecklist.evidence: runtime secrets stay in /etc/seis/ssh-ai.env and local readiness reports remain ignored.

mobileHandoffChecklist.requirement: A new computer can recreate the same mobile SSH entrypoint without copying private runtime state from the old Mac.
mobileHandoffChecklist.evidence: bootstrap:plan, config:plan, probe:strict, and doctor:strict commands are documented in the runbook.
